newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Police confirm 79 died in Indonesia riot - report.
newsitem.headline: Police confirm 79 died in Indonesia riot - report.

text.p: Police in the Indonesian city of Banjarmasin have confirmed that 79 people died in rioting on Friday, the official Antara news agency reported on Sunday.

The news agency said the bodies of 75 people were found in a burned-out shopping complex in the city, the capital of Borneo's South Kalimantan province, while four others died from stab wounds and burns elsewhere in the city.

At least 100 people were being treated in four Banjarmasin hospitals for stab wounds or burn injuries, Antara said. Eight shopping centres, 130 houses, 21 cars, 60 motorcycles and three hotels were burned in the rioting and four government buildings were damaged, it quoted police as saying.
It did not mention any damage to churches but witnesses said at least seven churches were looted, burned or stoned.

The rioting broke out after clashes between supporters of the ruling Golkar party and the rival Moslem-oriented United Development Party (PPP) on the last day of campaigning for the country's May 29 general elections.
